manifesto.label: Manifesto
manifesto.headline: What we believe.
manifesto.p1Body: We charge for what we deliver, not for the time it takes. That changes everything: incentives, speed, quality. If something runs over, that's our problem — not yours.
manifesto.p2Body: A traditional agency's timeline isn't built for your speed. Ours is. We use precise engineering and processes that remove friction without cutting corners. Fast isn't the opposite of good — it's the same thing, done right.
manifesto.p3Body: Every project uses the right stack for the problem, not the trendiest one. You get a product that works, scales, and can be maintained. You don't need to understand how it works inside to trust that it does.
